sourceNotes.note: Season-long route/target efficiency for Devaughn Vele vs rookie Jordyn Tyson debut usage.
McVay confirms CJ Daniels will see more snaps/field time amid Nacua IR and depleted WR room.
Listed healthy Rams WRs (Mumpfield, Atwell, Whittington, Daniels); noted Nacua IR timeline unclear, Adams Week 12 best-case, Ferguson week-to-week.
Follow-up details on Michael Wilson season-ending neck injury (already reported earlier).

items.text:
Devaughn Vele (season): WR3 in routes per game (38.0), WR30 in targets (49), WR60 in TPRR (0.16)

Jordyn Tyson's NFL debut: 15 routes, 4 targets, 0.27 TPRR

Devaughn Vele: 42 routes, 4 targets, 0.13 TPRR

The No. 8 overall pick ran a route on just 33.3% of the Saints' dropbacks (Vele: 93.3%) and still drew as many targets.

His time is coming.
items.why: Vele leads in routes but lags in target rate; Tyson efficient on limited snaps in debut.
items.implication: Vele holds high route share but target competition rising with Tyson.
items.opportunity: Watch Tyson for expanded role; Vele remains a volume play.

items.text: Sean McVay: "No doubt about it" rookie WR CJ Daniels will be someone who will get opportunities to see more snaps/field time moving forward
items.why: Depleted WR room with Nacua to IR (MCL/PCL/turf toe) and Adams on IR; McVay explicitly projects more opportunities for Daniels.
items.implication: Daniels and other healthy Rams WRs (Mumpfield, Atwell, Whittington) see expanded roles.
items.opportunity: CJ Daniels becomes a viable waiver target or deeper league start amid Rams WR injuries.
